body.statement:
Let \(H\) be an SCG induced by a full-time acyclic directed mixed graph of a stationary dynamic structural causal model whose directed temporal lag is bounded by \(L\), and let the query lag satisfy \(\gamma\in\{0,L\}\).  For a nonempty \(\mathbb W\subseteq V\setminus\{X,Y\}\), if \(\mathsf{FD}_{\mathrm{A25}}(H,\mathbb W,X,Y,\gamma,L)\) holds and the observational distribution is strictly positive, then
\[
 P(Y_0=y\mid\operatorname{do}(X_{-\gamma}=x))
 =F_{\mathrm{A25},\mathbb W}(P;y,x).
\]
The result is sufficient only: it does not assert necessity of the four graphical conditions.

source.locator: Definition 7 and Theorem 1, Equation (1), arXiv:2406.05805v2, Section 4
source.verbatim_statement: Section 2: gamma simply specifies the lag of interest for the query posed by the user. In the remainder of the paper, gamma is considered to be in {0,gamma_max}. Definition 7: W intercepts all activated directed paths from X to Y; there is no activated back-door path from X to W; all back-door paths from W to Y are blocked by X; and either Cycles(X,G^s) is empty, or Cycles(X,G^s)={X->X} with no bidirected X--Z for an ancestor Z of X, or gamma=0. Theorem 1: If W satisfies Definition 7 relative to (X_{t-gamma},Y_t) and Pr(s)>0, then Pr(y_t | do(x_{t-gamma})) is identifiable and is given by Equation (1): sum_f sum_bx Pr(f | x_{t-gamma},bx)Pr(bx) times sum_{bf,x-prime} Pr(y_t | f,bf,x-prime)Pr(bf,x-prime), with F, Bx, and Bf defined immediately below the equation.
